name: How do I choose the right contractor for cabinet refinishing?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for cabinet refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for cabinet refinishing, look for experience, positive customer reviews, and a portfolio of past work. Ensure they are licensed and insured. Obtain detailed written estimates that clearly outline the scope of work, materials, and timeline. Communicate your expectations clearly and ask about their process for managing disruptions during the project. A reputable contractor will be transparent and responsive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, reviews, portfolio, licensing, detailed estimates, and clear communication.
